title: Combat And Camera System Spec

loops.name: Combat Core Loop
loops.reward: new route, loot, lore, or mastery tell

cinematic_lighting_presets.boss_intro: Low-key amber rim light with readable silhouette
cinematic_lighting_presets.safe_room: Soft top light with reduced contrast and no combat pulses

atmospheric_density_profiles.foundry_clear: Low haze for precision combat reads
atmospheric_density_profiles.hazard_warning: Medium ember haze outside active telegraph zones

recoil_profiles.sidearm: Short upward kick with fast return
recoil_profiles.heavy: Strong camera impulse with reduced-motion fallback

ui_transition_styles.victory: Reward reveal with breathing room and next action

boss_intro_sequences.phaseTwo: Short music stem shift, arena light cue, new tell

loot_drop_animation_profiles.rare: Short arc, readable color frame, bright chime
loot_drop_animation_profiles.legendary: Short silence, orange reveal, signature sting

combat_intensity_layers.ambient: Exploration bed with no threat rhythm

ambient_zone_profiles.safe_room: Low drones, soft UI sounds, no danger pulses
ambient_zone_profiles.storm_foundry: Metal groans and distant vent pressure

rarity_audio_cues.legendary: Signature sting with short silence before reveal

danger_alert_profiles.low_health: Filtered heartbeat with accessibility-safe visual pair

audioCues.parry: bright metal snap plus low impact layer
audioCues.danger: short rising stinger before unblockable pressure
audioCues.reward: warm harmonic rise after shortcut unlock

risks.label: Animation workload
risks.mitigation: Limit launch weapon families and share anticipation poses.

risks.label: Feedback overload
risks.mitigation: Reserve brightest VFX for damage, healing, objective, and boss phase changes.

benchmarks.lesson: Readable tells and recovery windows make difficulty feel fair.
benchmarks.caution: Do not copy specific attacks, UI, or boss identities.

constraints: Ship reduced motion and camera shake sliders

production.milestone: Vertical slice combat encounter with one captain, one hazard, and one shortcut reward.
production.assetBudget: One hero rig, one captain rig, two shared enemy silhouettes, one foundry kit, three VFX families.
qaFocus: Camera comfort on controller and mouse
No reward inflation from replay variants
engineNotes: Unreal: block out camera and combat timing in Blueprint before C++ optimization.
Unity: keep combat reactions modular for mobile/PC build targets.
Godot: use lightweight animation trees and authored encounter variants.

scalingVariants.tradeoff: One arena, one weapon family, no networking.
Three encounters and one boss phase with shared animation sets.
Multiple factions, telemetry tuning, and procedural replay modifiers.
Full cinematic combat pipeline with dedicated camera, animation, VFX, and audio teams.

telemetry.signal: post-death reason selection and combat event log
telemetry.designQuestion: Do players understand why they failed before retrying?
telemetry.action: Improve telegraph, HUD state, or camera framing before increasing stats.

telemetry.designQuestion: Does the reward cadence create healthy one-more-run motivation?
telemetry.action: Tune cache value, faction reputation, and replay modifier visibility.

iterationGoals: Reduce camera occlusion before adding enemy count.
Make parry and dodge windows readable through animation, VFX, audio, and haptics.
Keep the vertical slice small enough for weekly playtest builds.
ethics: Retention hooks must explain their value and avoid punishment for missed sessions.

platformAdaptation.input: one-thumb dodge plus contextual attack assist
platformAdaptation.performance: reduced VFX particle counts and baked lighting
platformAdaptation.readability: larger telegraph shapes and simplified HUD

platformAdaptation.input: keyboard/mouse precision with remappable combat verbs
platformAdaptation.performance: scalable shadows, VFX density, and ultrawide HUD bounds

platformAdaptation.input: controller-first lock-on, radial item select, haptic tells
platformAdaptation.performance: stable frame pacing over peak VFX density

playtestQuestions: Do players understand why they failed?
Which reward beat makes them want one more attempt?
Does the camera ever hide the next threat?
